source.rulesVersion: 2024 baseline unless active entry says otherwise

compendium.summary: A situational single-ally speed, defense and restricted-action buff. Its concentration cost and ending penalty make it a poor default substitute for broad control.
warnings: The Compendium index is an operating reference, not replacement spell text. Confirm the active D&D Beyond entry before casting.
tactics: Choose Haste for a concrete objective or ally interaction. The extra action is restricted; it is not a second unrestricted spellcasting action.
When it ends, the target is Incapacitated with Speed 0 until the end of its next turn. Voluntarily switching concentration can therefore endanger the ally.

Pack Tactics is strongly negative about its opportunity cost. That is optimization advice, not a prohibition: compare the particular ally's gain with enemy turns denied by Web, Hypnotic Pattern or Sleet Storm.
